name: Panel Type From JSON
description: Read a PanelType from a JSON file: a library type shipped with timber_design (e.g. the dataholz.eu buildups awrhho05b, awrhhi01a, awmhhi01a), or a file written by CT: Custom Panel Type, CT: Stud Wall Panel Type or save_panel_type().

inputParameters.name: filepath
inputParameters.description: Path of a JSON file, or the name of a library type (see 'available').

outputParameters.name: panel_type
outputParameters.description: PanelType. Connect to CT: Create Populator.

outputParameters.name: info
outputParameters.description: The type's thickness, layers, agents and detail sets.

outputParameters.name: available
outputParameters.description: The names of the library types.
